content.short: Kerberus Sentinel3 automatically detects and blocks scam sites in real time, protecting Web3 users since January 2023.
content.description: Kerberus Sentinel3 identifies and blocks 99.9% of Web3 sites designed or hacked to steal crypto and NFTs across all EVM chains. It delivers protection against address poisoning and fake accounts on X, and it issues timely alerts during Web3 emergency events to help users respond swiftly. It also safeguards Web3 transactions up to $30k, helping to keep profits secure and to minimize exposure to loss across ongoing on-chain activity.
content.meta: Kerberus Sentinel3 detects and blocks 99.9% of Web3 scam sites. Discover Kerberus Sentinel3 and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Address Poisoning Attacks: How They Scam Web3 Users
resources.tldr: The attack works because people verify the first and last few characters of an address and nothing in between. Covers detection and the habits that defeat it.

resources.title: Human Behavior Causes 44% of Web3 Losses
resources.tldr: Research putting nearly half of crypto theft down to human error rather than broken code, despite the billions spent on securing the code.

resources.title: Solana Security: Automated Defense for Wallets and Programs
resources.tldr: $250M lost on Solana in a single half-year, most of it to phishing and social engineering rather than protocol bugs. On catching those at transaction time.
